use_when: Moving first is costly; adoption depends on others joining; incompatible standards or multiple stable outcomes
avoid_when: Not a solution when someone benefits from defecting even after others join
perspective: Distinguish alignment and common expectations from conflicts of interest; inspect equilibrium selection

use_when: Joint gains exist but an actor can gain by defecting; repeated interaction and trust matter
avoid_when: Do not assume repetition guarantees cooperation or sanctions are credible
perspective: Check individual deviation incentives and future relationship value; allow mistakes and exit

use_when: Hidden effort or action; delegated work; rewarded metrics diverge from real goals
avoid_when: Not hidden preexisting quality or risk; do not assume deliberate cheating
perspective: Separate observable proxy from objective; examine effort incentives and who bears downside

use_when: Hidden quality or risk before agreement; claims and signals; uncertainty changes who participates
avoid_when: Not hidden post-agreement effort; cost or confident speech alone does not prove honesty
perspective: Distinguish adverse selection from signaling by the informed and screening by the uninformed

use_when: Promises become unattractive later; sequential decisions; irreversible investment or hold-up
avoid_when: Do not infer credibility from threats or recommend burning options as a general strategy
perspective: Reconstruct future choices and incentives to honor a commitment; check enforcement and renegotiation

use_when: Gains exist but terms stall; alternatives differ; delay or relationship-specific dependence changes power
avoid_when: No automatic fair split; bargaining power does not establish legitimacy
perspective: Inspect credible outside options and time pressure; separate total gains from their distribution

use_when: Multiple approvals; vetoes; coalitions; agenda-setting; nominal support does not produce a decision
avoid_when: No general coalition theorem or optimal political strategy without actual rules
perspective: Reconstruct who can propose approve block implement or exit under the real decision procedure

use_when: Shared resources; public goods; free riding; benefits and maintenance duties are separated
avoid_when: Neither inevitable collapse nor universal superiority of local governance
perspective: Inspect participation boundaries allocation monitoring legitimate enforcement and who can change rules

use_when: An incentive changes meaning trust or who joins; reciprocity fairness or identity matters; people adapt
avoid_when: Not evidence that incentives always crowd out norms or norms always help
perspective: Trace changes in beliefs motivations composition and feedback; compare deterrence and capacity rivals
